scope: Path-redacted index of 27 completed small real-model integration runs across implementation iterations. Original immutable records and outputs remain in ignored local results. These are not a full paper grid.
limits: Only the existing Gemma expert server was used; the other three experts and the real LOTUS proxy were not started.
Weight revisions are operator declarations, not independent attestations of the live server.
Server prefix caching and concurrent validation were uncontrolled; observed seconds are not a controlled speedup comparison.
Earlier protocol runs are implementation diagnostics and cannot be combined with the current protocol in the reporter.
Complete 2116-run grids, confidence intervals, publication figure reconstruction and paper-wide numerical claims remain unverified.
Raw failed attempts are preserved locally; only successful completed records are indexed here.
